overview: The council reviewed proposed bicycle routes and funding, addressed neighborhood impacts of the Malden Hospital redevelopment proposal, and voted to reappoint a member to the Brooks Estate board. They also examined street sweeping enforcement concerns and discussed MassDOT's role in the Medford Peace Garden project.

items.title: Bicycle Roadway Funding and Proposed Routes
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution referring proposed bike lane routes to the Traffic Commission and administration to clarify specific street addresses and evaluate impacts on residential parking.

items.title: Malden Hospital Site Redevelopment
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution calling for an emergency-access barrier on Lund Road, neighborhood meeting notifications, an Office of Community Development position report, and an invitation to the developer for a Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Riverside Avenue School Crossing Guard
items.summary: Placed on file after Police Chief Leo Sacco reported that police officers are covering the McGlynn Andrews school crossing post while new traffic supervisor recruits are vetted and trained.

items.title: Item 14-757
items.summary: Placed on file following withdrawal by the petitioner.

items.title: Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust Board Appointment
items.summary: Reappointed Councilor Robert Penta retroactively to the Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust board through 2016 following debate regarding performance evaluation metrics for council appointments.

items.title: Commendation for Father Toomey
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Father Toomey of St. Raphael's Parish on celebrating 36 years in the priesthood.

items.title: Street Sweeping Notifications and Towing
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution seeking fee relief for residents ticketed or towed when scheduled street sweeping did not occur, and requesting leaf clearance along Oak Grove Cemetery.

items.title: Service Updates and Peace Garden MassDOT Hearing
items.summary: Heard administrative updates on waste collection and street lighting, and voted to request an Office of Community Development report concerning a MassDOT hearing on land acquisitions and easements for the Medford Peace Garden.

items.title: 2015 Council Leadership Caucus Announcement
items.summary: Approved council records and announced the caucus results selecting Councilor Fred Dello Russo as President-Elect and Councilor Breanna Lungo-Koehn as Vice-President-Elect for 2015.
